skill.summary: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the find-skills skill.

- Introduces a skill for discovering and installing agent skills based on user queries.
- Provides detailed guidance on when and how to offer skill recommendations.
- Explains usage of the Skills CLI for searching, adding, and updating skills.
- Includes best practices for helping users find relevant skills and what to do if no skill matches.
- Lists common skill categories and search tips to improve discovery.
